old_cut.notes: Spot checks: 32-64 s runs S01 1.0 s, R89 Stanford 0.5 s, R86, lecture, F34 hand, R91, S15 2 s in 10 s; 37/67 shots <2.5 s; 12 luma swings >25/255 within 0.5 s (new: 0 outside planned black/fades); frame-diff p90 8.6 (new 5.4); line gap 0.12 s, xf 0.6. Cues used the same 0.25 s lead-in, so sync was already fine.

method: 2 fps contact strips + 5 frames across every transition; cue vs align.json word starts (all 22 cues: cut 0.25 s before the word, xf midpoint +0.25 s, dissolve midpoint +0.55 s); luma/frame-diff at 10 fps; silences from align.json. Axes equal weight, pass >= 9.0.
